folder.description: The folder for which to configure logging settings. This specifies the organizational scope where the logging settings will be applied.
folder.rationale: Proper folder scoping ensures that logging settings are applied to the intended organizational hierarchy and don't inadvertently affect other parts of the organization.

kms_key_name.description: The resource name for the customer-managed Cloud KMS key used to encrypt log data. This provides enhanced security control over log encryption.
kms_key_name.rationale: Using customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) provides greater control over log data encryption and meets regulatory requirements for data protection.

storage_location.description: The default storage location that Cloud Logging will use when creating new resources where a location is needed but not explicitly provided. This controls where log data is stored geographically.
storage_location.rationale: Controlling log storage location is critical for data sovereignty, compliance with regional data protection laws, and minimizing latency for log access.

disable_default_sink.description: When set to true, the _Default sink in newly created projects and folders will be created in a disabled state. This helps prevent duplicate log storage when using aggregated sinks.
disable_default_sink.rationale: Disabling default sinks prevents unnecessary log duplication and reduces storage costs while ensuring all logs are properly captured through centralized aggregated sinks.
